facebook.content_angle: Three things East Auckland buyers notice within the first 60 seconds of an open home — and how sellers can use this to their advantage
facebook.post_text:
Most buyers make up their mind before they reach the kitchen. 🏡

You can have the best price in the street, but if the first impression doesn't land — buyers emotionally check out before they've even seen the best parts of your home.

Here's what East Auckland buyers are noticing first right now:
👉 The smell and light the moment the front door opens
👉 How the entrance flows into the main living space
👉 Whether the home feels looked after — or like hard work

These three things happen in under 60 seconds. And they directly influence how high a buyer is willing to go. 💡

Before your next open home, focus here:
✔️ Fresh air, natural light, and a clutter-free entrance
✔️ A clean, well-lit path from front door to living area
✔️ Small details — handles, skirting, light switches — that signal pride of ownership

The buyers walking through East Auckland open homes this autumn are motivated. The homes that feel move-in ready are the ones attracting strong offers.

What's the first thing you notice when you walk into a home for the first time?
